fields.before: No Figma component; the style exists only as text styles (Figma), a font macro value (React Spectrum) and one Typography stylesheet (SWC). One explicit root part, text; margins are properties of it. Owner decision D1 (2026-11-19): keep five components.
fields.after: No Figma component; the style exists only as text styles (Figma), a font macro value (React Spectrum) and one Typography stylesheet (SWC). Keep five components, one family. The text part holds the type style; margins are properties of it. The container part is a recipe-drawing root: the engine needs a box root and a root text part draws nothing, so the part owns only recipe alignment values; a spec change to allow a recipe-only root is tracked separately.
